read.thesis: Shell Q3 2026 beat on refining and trading cash, cash capex cut ~$1bn to $23–25bn, net debt down to $39.7bn, and a $5bn buyback topped up from $3bn, with no supply-side read on industry capacity.

utilisation.quote: Refinery Utilization -- 96%, impacted by low water levels on the Rhine river affecting the Rheinland refinery.

capex.quote: we brought it down by roughly $1 billion. A large part of that is really timing and phasing with a few efficiencies built in.

triggers.label: Cash capex cut ~$1bn to $23–25bn

triggers.label: Spot freight costs pushing down margins
triggers.quote: cost on anything which is spot is definitely going up and beginning to push down on margins
triggers.highlight: beginning to push down on margins

triggers.label: Q4 refining realisations seen lower
triggers.quote: We do believe we could see lower realized numbers coming through this quarter given the freight rates
triggers.highlight: lower realized numbers coming through this quarter

triggers.label: Chemicals sale/combination in deep talks
triggers.quote: We are in deep discussions. I won't comment on who and what at this stage

guidance.quote: Our cash CapEx range for 2026 is now between $23 billion and $25 billion, which includes some $4 billion for the acquisition of ARC Resources.

guidance.value: 40% to 50% of CFFO through the cycle
guidance.quote: Our policy of shareholder distributions of 40% to 50% of CFFO through the cycle remains sacrosanct
we have announced a further $5 billion share buyback program, which we expect to complete by the time of our Q4 results announcement
